question: Which Indian athlete has been appointed as a Puma Brand ambassador in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dutee Chand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dutee Chand**, an Indian professional sprinter and current national champion in the women's 100 meters event, was appointed as a Puma Brand ambassador in 2019.
 
• She is the third Indian athlete to sign up with Puma, joining the likes of Virat Kohli and Mary Kom.
 
• Dutee Chand has been a prominent figure in Indian athletics and her association with Puma highlights her contributions and achievements in the sport.
 
• This partnership with Puma aims to inspire and encourage more young athletes to pursue their passion in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dutee Chand** has represented India in multiple international competitions, including the Asian Games and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to win a gold medal in the 100 meters at the World University Games in 2019.
 
• Her journey and achievements have been a source of inspiration for many aspiring athletes in India.
 
• Puma's association with Dutee Chand is part of their broader strategy to support and promote sports and athletes in India.
